question: do reported earnings and cash reflect economic reality?

earnings_versus_cash.finding: Over the trailing four quarters operating cash flow is {earnings_versus_cash.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} times net income. The company's own fiscal years print {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} for 2025, {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.1.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} for 2024, {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.2.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} for 2023, {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.3.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} for 2022, {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.4.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} for 2021 and {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.5.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} for 2020. The current reading sits inside that range, above 2025 and below 2024. Trailing operating cash flow grew {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.trailing_four_quarters|pct}, against net income growth of {ratios.growth.net_income.trailing_four_quarters|pct}. Accruals over average assets are {earnings_versus_cash.accruals_over_average_assets}, negative because cash exceeds income. The annual cells, which use year-end assets, print {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets} for 2025, {trend_table.years-back-1.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets} for 2024 and {trend_table.years-back-2.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets} for 2023, the highest filled year. So accruals stay negative as in every filled year, although the trailing and annual denominators differ and the two are not strictly comparable. Quarterly accruals are filled in too few quarters to support a trend, and the latest quarter's cell is empty because the 10-Q states operating cash flow only year to date. Working capital: against a year earlier, inventory rose {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.balance_sheet_change}, or {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.share_of_net_income|pct} of trailing net income. Receivables rose {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.balance_sheet_change} ({earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.share_of_net_income|pct}), while accounts payable rose only {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.balance_sheet_change} ({earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.share_of_net_income|pct}). Trade working capital absorbed {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_firm.inputs.change_in_trade_working_capital} over the year. Inventory is the main absorber, and management says the build is deliberate. Since year-end, payables and accrued liabilities have both fallen, which also used cash. Articulation: the balance-sheet rise in inventory exceeds the cash-flow statement's inventory change of {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.cash_flow_statement_change} by {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.articulation_gap}. The benign reading is inventory that arrived with acquisitions through investing rather than operating cash flow, which the record cannot confirm. Receivables and payables articulation cannot be computed: the record holds no full-year receivables change line for 2025 and no payables change line in any period. Smoothness is {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness}, well below one, so quarterly net income moves far less than quarterly operating cash flow. Cash swings from {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness.operating_cash_flow.4} in the June 2025 quarter to {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness.operating_cash_flow.2} in the December 2025 quarter and {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness.operating_cash_flow.6} in the December 2024 quarter. That is a recurring fourth-quarter collection pattern, and no earlier smoothness reading is on record to compare against. The quarter's operating cash flow of {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.this_quarter} rose {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.year_over_year|pct} year on year. The release credits lower tax payments, which may be timing, and receivable sales (see cash-flow engineering) also support operating cash.
earnings_versus_cash.verdict: Earnings are backed by cash. Operating cash flow exceeds net income within the company's own historical range, and accruals stay negative. The caveats are an inventory build that absorbs a rising share of earnings, an unexplained inventory articulation gap, and operating cash partly supported by receivable sales and by lower tax payments.

revenue_recognition.finding: Receivables are outrunning revenue on an annual basis. Days sales outstanding for 2025 is {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}, the highest of the filled years, against {trend_table.years-back-3.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} in 2022. Receivables over revenue for 2025, {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.receivables_over_revenue}, is also the highest of the filled years, and 2024 is second highest on both. In the quarterly table this quarter prints {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}, second highest of the filled quarters. That is down from {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} in the first quarter, the highest, and above {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} a year earlier. The trailing measure on average balances is {ratios.efficiency.days_sales_outstanding}. The quarter's improvement coincides with a new row of current trade receivable sales in the 10-Q, so part of the drop may reflect receivables sold rather than collected. Year over year, receivables grew {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.balance_sheet_change}, while quarterly revenue grew {ratios.growth.revenue.year_over_year|pct}. Contract liabilities stand at {terms.balances_now.contract_liabilities} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.contract_liabilities} a year earlier. Against quarterly revenue they print {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue}, third highest of the filled quarters, down seasonally from {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue}. They move with revenue, not against it, and contract assets fell from year-end. On judgment areas, there is a small cumulative catch-up reversal driven by changes in estimates of progress on system contracts. The remaining-performance-obligation totals are unchanged from the prior quarter while the release reports record backlog, and the note attributes the difference to software and services contracts terminable for convenience. Neither report shows new wording on variable consideration, principal versus agent, standalone selling price, extended payment terms or bill-and-hold. Fourth-quarter revenue concentration cannot be measured, because the record does not derive fourth quarters. On growth quality, quarterly revenue of {ratios.growth.revenue.this_quarter} grew {ratios.growth.revenue.year_over_year|pct} as reported, but the release's organic growth is far lower and acquisitions supply most of the difference.
revenue_recognition.verdict: No recognition-policy change and no sign of pulled-forward revenue. However, annual receivables have reached their highest level against revenue in the record, and the quarter's improvement in days outstanding is entangled with newly sold receivables. Reported growth is mainly acquired.

estimates_and_reserves.finding: The allowance for doubtful accounts covers {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio|pct} of gross receivables, the lowest of the filled quarters, against {trend_table.quarters-back-5.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio|pct} in the first quarter of 2025. On the annual table 2025 prints {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio|pct}, the lowest of the filled years, against {trend_table.years-back-4.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio|pct} in 2021. The allowance is {terms.balances_now.bad_debt_allowance} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.bad_debt_allowance} a year earlier, while receivables and days outstanding sit near their highs. The company says its election of the credit-loss practical expedient had no material impact. The inventory reserve covers {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.inventory_reserve_ratio|pct} of inventory, the lowest of the filled quarters. That compares with {trend_table.quarters-back-7.ratios.inventory_reserve_ratio|pct} in the September 2024 quarter and {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.inventory_reserve_ratio|pct} a year earlier, and 2025 is the lowest filled year at {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.inventory_reserve_ratio|pct}. The reserve rose to {terms.balances_now.inventory_reserve} from {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.inventory_reserve}, while inventory rose to {terms.balances_now.inventory} from {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.inventory}, so coverage has not kept pace with the build. For warranty, the record tags no entity-wide accrual in any period, so no ratio exists. Among this quarter's estimates, the IEEPA tariff refund raises income. It was recognized in cost of sales on management's judgment that recovery of a portion is now probable: a one-time recovery booked in an operating line. It helped lift gross margin to {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin|pct}, the highest of the filled quarters, from {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.gross_margin|pct}, the lowest. The refund amount is not a calculator field, so no earnings adjustment can be written for it. A small reversal of restructuring accruals no longer needed also raises income. The remaining estimate changes lower income: an upward remeasurement of the Silvus earnout liability on a level-three Monte Carlo model, a net increase in unrecognized tax benefits that raised the quarter's GAAP rate, and a shorter top end of the contract-cost amortization range. The six-month rate fell on excess tax benefits from share awards and a larger export deduction, discrete items the calculator cannot isolate. The trailing effective rate is {tax_rate.effective_rate|pct}. Neither report covers goodwill headroom, discount rates or growth assumptions, so no impairment-testing finding is possible.
estimates_and_reserves.verdict: Reserves are thinning. Both the bad-debt and inventory reserve ratios are at their lowest in the record while receivables and inventory are near their highs. The quarter's margin carries a one-time refund recognized on a probability judgment. The other estimate changes this period mostly lower income rather than raise it.

cost_deferral.finding: Capitalized software or development cost is not tagged in any period, so it cannot be set against research and development expense of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.research_and_development_expense} over the trailing four quarters. Nothing was found on that test, for lack of data. The share of assets that is neither cash nor plant is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share|pct}, the highest of the filled quarters, against {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.soft_asset_share|pct} a year earlier. The annual cell for 2025, {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share|pct}, is the highest of the filled years, against {trend_table.years-back-4.ratios.soft_asset_share|pct} in 2021. The cause is acquisition goodwill and intangibles, not capitalized operating cost: goodwill is far above its 2024 year-end balance. Note that the quarterly and annual cells rest on different plant concepts. Depreciation and amortization over the trailing four quarters is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.depreciation_and_amortization}, against {terms.trailing_four_quarters.depreciation_and_amortization.parts.prior_fiscal_year} for 2025, as acquired intangibles amortize. Several 'non-recurring' items recur. Hytera litigation gains appear in 2024, in 2025 and in the first half of 2026. They run through GAAP Other charges, so GAAP operating earnings carry a recurring non-operating gain stream, which non-GAAP removes. Reorganization charges recur and are excluded from non-GAAP. The earnout adjustment is excluded although the earnout will be settled in shares. By contrast, the one-time IEEPA refund stays inside non-GAAP earnings and inside the base for the raised guidance. This asymmetry flatters non-GAAP. The calculator cannot fill the non-GAAP gap in any period. The release prints non-GAAP net earnings well above GAAP, with intangibles amortization and share-based compensation both larger than a year earlier, so the gap has widened, mostly from acquisition amortization.
cost_deferral.verdict: There is no sign that operating cost is being capitalized; soft-asset growth comes from acquisitions. Earnings quality is diluted on presentation: non-GAAP keeps a one-time refund while removing other one-time items, and GAAP operating earnings include recurring litigation gains.

cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh.finding: Proceeds from sales of receivables total {terms.trailing_four_quarters.proceeds_from_sale_of_receivables} over the trailing four quarters, against {terms.trailing_four_quarters.proceeds_from_sale_of_receivables.parts.prior_fiscal_year} for 2025. The six months print {terms.trailing_four_quarters.proceeds_from_sale_of_receivables.parts.this_year_to_date}, against {terms.trailing_four_quarters.proceeds_from_sale_of_receivables.parts.prior_year_to_date}. The 10-Q's receivable-sales table now has an 'Accounts receivable sales proceeds' row with amounts only in the 2026 columns, while its lead-in still describes long-term receivables only. Selling current receivables lifts operating cash without a customer collection and lowers days outstanding. The whole field is therefore set against free cash flow ({free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple}) as a reducing adjustment. Commitments to finance customers rose, so the long-term receivable pipeline that feeds these sales is growing. The supplier finance obligation is {terms.balances_now.supplier_finance_obligation} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.supplier_finance_obligation} a year earlier: small and falling, so it is not lifting operating cash. The calculator has no row for purchase obligations or guarantee exposure in this period, so neither can be assessed. The operating lease liability is roughly flat at {terms.balances_now.operating_lease_liability} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.operating_lease_liability}. No variable-interest entity appears in either report. On classification, the calculator finds no tagged acquisition line in any period ({terms.cash_flow_families.acquisitions}). Yet the reports describe acquired revenue, purchase accounting for Silvus and for the acquisitions of early 2026, and a strategic equity investment in BRINC. The acquisition input to free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted is {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted.inputs.acquisitions.cash_spent}, so that measure must be read as before acquisition spending. The calculator also records no debt-issuance inflow year to date ({terms.cash_flow_families.borrowing_issued.parts.this_year_to_date}), although commercial paper was outstanding at quarter-end. Share-based compensation over the trailing four quarters is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation}, against {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.share_based_compensation} in 2025 and {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.2.share_based_compensation} in 2023. It is already subtracted in free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted ({free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted}). From 2026 the retirement-plan match is paid in stock rather than cash, so that cost no longer leaves as cash; its amount is not a calculator field. The Silvus earnout is payable in shares, so that consideration will never appear in cash flow either.
cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh.verdict: Operating cash is partly supported by receivable sales, including a new current-receivable programme, and that field is adjusted out. Supplier finance is small and shrinking. The calculator's adjusted free cash flow subtracts no acquisition spending, so it overstates the cash left after investment. Non-cash share settlement is growing: equity awards, the retirement match and the earnout.

controls_audit_and_filing_signals.finding: No material weakness, auditor change or critical audit matter is visible. The 10-Q carries no auditor's report, and its controls section states that disclosure controls are effective with no change in internal control; the notes reader found no change in substance. No reader flagged an officer departure, but only the item codes of other 8-Ks were carried, so this is an absence of evidence rather than evidence of absence. The late-filing section reports none. On quiet restatement, the numbers reader compared superseded 10-K facts with the 10-Q and found matching values, so no prior value was restated. One tag change: the quarterly soft-asset cells use a plant concept that includes finance-lease right-of-use assets, while the annual cells use a different concept; the year-end value is the same under both. Several disclosure signals differ from the company's past. The D-Fend and Bell Mobility agreements have no material-agreement 8-K item in the item-code list, although earlier agreements did. The Hytera paragraph dropped the sentence that separated what Hytera paid from cash received net of withholding. The Bell Mobility segment-assignment sentence was removed. The earnout's income-statement line is called 'Other income, net' in one paragraph and 'Other charges' elsewhere. And the receivable-sales lead-in still says long-term receivables only, although a current-receivable row now appears. Related parties, subsidiary-list changes and SEC comment letters are in neither report.
controls_audit_and_filing_signals.verdict: No control or audit red flag is visible and no prior value was restated. There are several disclosure-consistency gaps, including a removed sentence on Hytera cash receipts and a line-item wording conflict for the earnout.

cross_document_reconciliation.finding: Among the notes items that carry a direction, the numbers confirm these claims: the earnout charge, the earnout liability remeasurement, the higher quarterly tax rate, the inventory build, the margin effect of the IEEPA refund on the consolidated and products margins, higher interest payments, lower tax payments with higher operating cash, receivables falling against revenue this quarter, Hytera gains running higher, and higher operating cash alongside the stock-paid retirement match. They contradict the goodwill item: total goodwill rose while the prose describes a net goodwill reduction. The benign reading is goodwill added by the early-2026 acquisitions, but the Silvus portion cannot be isolated. The earnout line-item wording item is also contradicted, because the release reconciliation places the earnout under Other charges. Everything else is unresolved: either the numbers carry no line for it, or its horizon lies ahead. The 8-K and the 10-Q agree on quarterly revenue of {ratios.growth.revenue.this_quarter}, net income of {ratios.growth.net_income.this_quarter} and operating cash flow of {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.this_quarter}, the last derived from the 10-Q's year-to-date facts. The release's reported growth matches the calculator's {ratios.growth.revenue.year_over_year|pct}. The year-ago quarter's operating cash flow derived from filed facts is {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.year_over_year.inputs.before}, slightly different from the release's printed figure, most likely from rounding of year-to-date facts. The two documents label Other charges differently: the 10-Q places intangibles amortization inside it, while the release shows a separate line. They also explain the cash-flow increase differently, the release citing lower taxes and the 10-Q citing inventory and interest offsets; the numbers support both explanations. The six-month interest expense in the calculator, {terms.trailing_four_quarters.interest_expense.parts.this_year_to_date}, rests on a gross interest tag and is higher than the net interest tag the numbers reader quotes.
cross_document_reconciliation.verdict: The 8-K and the 10-Q agree on the headline numbers. One directional contradiction (goodwill) has a benign reading, one wording contradiction (the earnout line) is settled by the numbers, and the presentation labels differ between the two documents.

industry_lens.finding: Inventory obsolescence is the live risk. Inventory is {terms.balances_now.inventory} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.inventory} a year earlier. Days of inventory are {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory}, the highest of the filled quarters, against {trend_table.quarters-back-7.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory} in the September 2024 quarter, while the reserve ratio is at its low. Management plans to keep inventory elevated amid memory-cost inflation driven by AI demand. That combination raises the risk of later write-downs if component prices or demand turn. The record tags no inventory write-down, so none can be measured. The annual peak in days of inventory was 2022, at {trend_table.years-back-3.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory}, when the reserve ratio was also low at {trend_table.years-back-3.ratios.inventory_reserve_ratio|pct}. On purchase commitments in excess of need, there is no purchase-obligation row for this period, so nothing was found for lack of data, though buying ahead of memory costs is the kind of practice that creates such commitments. On customer concentration, the calculator's concentration facts are segment shares of revenue for 2025, not customer facts: {concentration.facts.0.value|pct} for Products and Systems Integration and {concentration.facts.1.value|pct} for Software and Services. No customer concentration is disclosed in the inputs, so nothing was found. On channel stuffing there is no sign: days outstanding fell in the quarter, contract liabilities rose with revenue, and growth is acquisition-led rather than loaded at period end. The caveat is that receivable sales lower days outstanding. On circular or vendor-financed deals, the company paid for a strategic equity stake in BRINC Drones, a public-safety drone maker. The note describes no customer or supplier relationship, so the stake cannot be classed as circular. Separately, commitments to finance customers rose; that is vendor financing, and it then feeds receivable sales.
industry_lens.verdict: Inventory obsolescence is the industry risk to watch: inventory days are at a record high while reserve coverage is at a record low. Customer concentration, channel stuffing and circular deals: nothing found in the inputs. Purchase commitments cannot be assessed.

anomalies.what: Quarterly revenue grew {ratios.growth.revenue.year_over_year|pct} as reported. The release attributes a large part to acquisitions and currency, and prints organic growth far lower for both the quarter and the half.

anomalies.name: Remaining performance obligations unchanged while backlog is a record
anomalies.what: The note's remaining-obligation totals are the same as in the prior quarter, while the release reports record backlog, up mainly in software and services. The note attributes the difference to contracts terminable for convenience.

anomalies.name: Revenue reversed on changed progress estimates for system contracts
anomalies.name_ko: 시스템 계약 진행률 추정 변경으로 매출 환입
anomalies.what: Revenue for obligations satisfied in earlier periods was reversed in the quarter because estimates of progress on system contracts changed, whereas the prior quarter recognized a catch-up. The amount is small, and the numbers carry no line for it.

anomalies.name: Bad-debt allowance coverage at its lowest while receivables are high
anomalies.what: Coverage is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio|pct}, the lowest of the filled quarters, and 2025 is the lowest of the filled years at {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio|pct}, while days outstanding are near their highs. The allowance is {terms.balances_now.bad_debt_allowance}.

anomalies.name: Credit-loss practical expedient elected
anomalies.what: The company elected to assume that balance-sheet-date conditions persist for current receivables and contract assets, and says this had no material impact. It changes how the allowance is estimated, at a time when the coverage ratio is at its low.

anomalies.name: Inventory reserve coverage at its lowest while inventory builds
anomalies.name_ko: 재고 증가 중 재고충당금 비율 최저
anomalies.what: The reserve covers {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.inventory_reserve_ratio|pct} of inventory, the lowest of the filled quarters, against {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.inventory_reserve_ratio|pct} a year earlier. The reserve rose to {terms.balances_now.inventory_reserve} while inventory rose to {terms.balances_now.inventory}. No prose explains the thinner coverage.

anomalies.name: One-time tariff refund booked in cost of sales on a probability judgment
anomalies.name_ko: 회수가능성 판단에 따른 일회성 관세 환급 인식
anomalies.what: Management judged recovery of a portion of the IEEPA refunds 'now probable' and credited cost of sales. Gross margin reached {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin|pct}, the highest of the filled quarters, from the lowest the quarter before. The refund amount is not a calculator field.

anomalies.name: Earnout liability remeasured upward on a level-three model
anomalies.what: The earnout fair value was raised on updated expectations that targets will be met. The charge runs through GAAP Other charges and is excluded from non-GAAP. The tagged liability change is positive against nil a year earlier.

anomalies.name: Net increase in unrecognized tax benefits raised the quarter's rate
anomalies.name_ko: 미인식 세무혜택 증가로 분기 세율 상승
anomalies.what: The GAAP quarterly rate rose on a net increase in unrecognized tax benefits, with no amount or jurisdiction given. Quarterly tax expense is higher than a year earlier. The trailing effective rate is {tax_rate.effective_rate|pct}.

anomalies.name: Six-month tax rate lowered by discrete items
anomalies.name_ko: 일회성 요인에 따른 반기 세율 하락
anomalies.what: The six-month rate fell on higher excess tax benefits from share awards and a larger export deduction. These are discrete items that raise net income, and the calculator carries no six-month rate field to test them.

anomalies.name: Restructuring accruals reversed as no longer needed
anomalies.what: Part of the reorganization accrual was reversed as no longer needed, both inside the quarter and in the half. It is a small income-raising estimate change, and the numbers carry no separate line for it.

anomalies.name: Top of the contract-cost amortization range shortened
anomalies.what: The amortization range for incremental contract costs now has a shorter top end than in the prior text, with no reason given. A shorter range speeds expense, so this change lowers rather than raises income. No numbers line covers it.

anomalies.name: Soft-asset share at its highest, driven by acquisitions
anomalies.name_ko: 인수로 인한 무형성 자산 비중 최고
anomalies.what: The non-cash, non-plant share of assets is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share|pct}, the highest of the filled quarters, against {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.soft_asset_share|pct} a year earlier. Goodwill is far above its 2024 year-end balance, and the reports describe the acquisitions that caused it.

anomalies.name: Recurring litigation gains inside GAAP operating earnings
anomalies.what: Hytera litigation gains were recorded in each of 2024, 2025 and the first half of 2026 within Other charges. They lift GAAP operating earnings with a non-operating stream that depends on collection, and non-GAAP removes them each time.

anomalies.name: One-time IEEPA refund kept inside non-GAAP earnings
anomalies.name_ko: 일회성 관세 환급을 비GAAP 이익에 포함
anomalies.what: The non-GAAP reconciliation removes Hytera gains and the earnout adjustment as highlighted items but keeps the one-time IEEPA refund. Non-GAAP earnings, and the raised full-year outlook that builds on them, therefore carry a non-repeating gain.

anomalies.name: Non-GAAP to GAAP gap widened, mostly from acquisition amortization
anomalies.what: The calculator cannot fill the gap in any period. The release prints non-GAAP net earnings well above GAAP, and both of its largest exclusions, intangibles amortization and share-based compensation, are larger than a year earlier.

anomalies.name: Reorganization charges recur and are excluded as highlighted items
anomalies.what: New severance charges were taken in 2026, with comparable prior-year charges. Reorganization costs are excluded from non-GAAP as highlighted items although they recur.

anomalies.name: New sales of current trade receivables support operating cash
anomalies.what: Receivable-sale proceeds are {terms.trailing_four_quarters.proceeds_from_sale_of_receivables} over the trailing four quarters. The table's new current-receivable row has amounts only in the 2026 columns, while its lead-in still describes long-term receivables only. Selling receivables brings cash in before customers pay.

anomalies.name: Commitments to finance customers rising
anomalies.what: Outstanding commitments to provide long-term financing to third parties rose since year-end, as did retained servicing obligations. This vendor financing becomes long-term receivables that the company then sells. No numbers line covers it.

anomalies.name: No acquisition outflow on record although acquisitions are described
anomalies.what: The calculator finds no tagged acquisition line in any period ({terms.cash_flow_families.acquisitions}), so free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted subtracts {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted.inputs.acquisitions.cash_spent} for acquisitions. Yet the reports describe acquired revenue, Silvus purchase accounting, acquisitions in early 2026 and a strategic equity purchase. The benign reading is a company-specific tag, but the adjusted free cash flow must be read as before acquisition spending.

anomalies.name: No borrowing inflow on record although commercial paper is new
anomalies.what: Debt issuance year to date is {terms.cash_flow_families.borrowing_issued.parts.this_year_to_date}, and no commercial-paper or net short-term borrowing line is tagged. Yet commercial paper was outstanding at quarter-end after none at the prior quarter-end. It is probably netted within short-term repayments of {terms.cash_flow_families.borrowing_repaid.parts.this_year_to_date}.

anomalies.name: Retirement-plan match switched from cash to stock
anomalies.name_ko: 퇴직연금 회사 매칭의 주식 지급 전환
anomalies.what: From 2026 the company match is paid in common stock, so a cost that used to leave as cash now dilutes shareholders instead and lifts operating cash. The amount is not a calculator field, so no adjustment can be written.

anomalies.name: Share-based compensation rising against its own history
anomalies.what: Trailing share-based compensation is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation}, against {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.share_based_compensation} in 2025 and {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.2.share_based_compensation} in 2023. It is a real cost with no cash outflow and is already subtracted in the adjusted free cash flow.

anomalies.name: Acquisition earnout payable in shares, outside cash flow
anomalies.what: The Silvus earnout is payable in shares over the coming measurement periods. Its fair value was raised this year, but settlement will never appear as a cash outflow, so part of the acquisition's cost bypasses free cash flow.

anomalies.name: Acquisition agreements without a material-agreement 8-K item
anomalies.what: The D-Fend and Bell Mobility definitive agreements have no material-agreement item in the 8-K item-code list, although earlier agreements had one. Whether one was required is a materiality judgment.

anomalies.name: Sentence on Hytera cash received net of withholding removed
anomalies.name_ko: Hytera 원천징수 후 수령액 문장 삭제
anomalies.what: The note no longer separates the amount Hytera paid from the cash the company received after withholding taxes. The gain is recognized on payments, so the cash behind the gain is now less visible.

anomalies.name: Segment assignment for the Bell Mobility business removed
anomalies.name_ko: Bell Mobility 사업 부문 배정 문장 삭제
anomalies.what: The sentence assigning the pending Bell Mobility business to both segments was removed, and a sentence with the same wording now sits in the Silvus paragraph.

anomalies.name: Earnout remeasurement attributed to two different income-statement lines
anomalies.name_ko: 언아웃 재측정 손익 계정 표기 불일치
anomalies.what: One paragraph says earnout fair-value changes go to Other income, net, while the fair-value note, the Other charges table and the release reconciliation place them in Other charges. The numbers side with Other charges.

anomalies.name: Receivable-sales lead-in still describes long-term receivables only
anomalies.what: The table and the MD&A lead-in describe sales of long-term receivables only, but the table now carries a current accounts-receivable sales row and the servicing sentence names both kinds.

anomalies.name: Quarterly and annual plant figures use different concepts
anomalies.what: The quarterly cells use a plant concept that includes finance-lease right-of-use assets, while the annual cells use net plant. The year-end value is identical under both, so no restated value results.

anomalies.name: Goodwill rose while the note describes a net reduction
anomalies.name_ko: 영업권 감소 설명과 달리 총액 증가
anomalies.what: Total goodwill is above its year-end balance, while the Silvus paragraph describes a net goodwill reduction from measurement-period adjustments. The benign reading is goodwill added by the acquisitions of early 2026, but the Silvus portion cannot be isolated.

anomalies.name: Year-ago quarterly operating cash flow differs slightly between filings and release
anomalies.name_ko: 전년 동기 분기 영업현금흐름의 미세한 차이
anomalies.what: Derived from filed year-to-date facts, the year-ago quarter's operating cash flow is {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.year_over_year.inputs.before}, slightly different from the figure the release prints. The likely cause is rounding of year-to-date facts. The current quarter matches at {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.this_quarter}.

anomalies.name: Other charges means different things in the 10-Q and the release
anomalies.what: The 10-Q places intangibles amortization inside Other charges, while the release prints it as a separate line, so the tagged other operating line matches no single release line.

anomalies.name: Release and 10-Q give different reasons for higher operating cash
anomalies.name_ko: 영업현금 증가 이유 설명의 문서 간 차이
anomalies.what: The release credits lower tax payments; the 10-Q cites higher earnings offset by inventory and interest payments. The numbers support both: taxes paid are lower, and interest paid and inventory use are higher.

anomalies.name: Calculator interest expense rests on a different tag from the statement line
anomalies.what: The calculator's six-month interest expense of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.interest_expense.parts.this_year_to_date} uses a gross interest tag. The statement's net interest line, quoted by the numbers reader, is lower, so the coverage ratio of {ratios.solvency.interest_coverage} rests on the gross figure.

anomalies.name: GAAP and non-GAAP tax-rate explanations point to different causes
anomalies.what: The 10-Q attributes the higher GAAP rate to unrecognized tax benefits, and the release attributes the lower non-GAAP rate to an export deduction. The release does not say whether the uncertain-tax increase was treated as a highlighted item.

anomalies.name: Record inventory days with record-low reserve coverage amid memory-cost inflation
anomalies.what: Days of inventory are {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory}, the highest of the filled quarters, and the reserve ratio is the lowest. Management intends to keep inventory elevated while memory costs rise. The record tags no inventory write-down.

anomalies.name: Strategic equity investment in a drone company
anomalies.name_ko: 드론 기업에 대한 전략적 지분 투자
anomalies.what: The company paid for an equity stake in BRINC Drones inside the quarter, carried at cost, with any revaluation gains routed to Other, net. No customer or supplier relationship is described, so a circular arrangement can be neither confirmed nor ruled out.

adjustments.name: Receivable sales proceeds removed from operating cash: a new current trade-receivable sales row plus continuing long-term receivable sales bring cash in before customers pay. Treated as one-time because the quote does not state that the programme will repeat.

summary_ko.earnings_versus_cash: 최근 네 분기 영업현금흐름은 순이익의 {earnings_versus_cash.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}배로, 2025년 {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}배와 2024년 {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.1.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}배 사이에 있어 이익이 현금으로 뒷받침됩니다. 다만 재고 증가가 순이익의 {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.share_of_net_income|pct}를 흡수했고, 이익의 분기 변동이 현금흐름 변동의 {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness}배에 그칠 만큼 이익이 현금보다 훨씬 매끄럽습니다.
summary_ko.revenue_recognition: 2025년 매출채권 회전일수는 {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}일로 기록된 연도 중 가장 높았고, 이번 분기의 하락은 새로 시작된 매출채권 매각과 시기가 겹쳐 회수 개선만으로 보기 어렵습니다. 분기 매출 성장률 {ratios.growth.revenue.year_over_year|pct}의 상당 부분은 인수에서 나왔습니다.
summary_ko.estimates_and_reserves: 대손충당금 비율 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio|pct}과 재고충당금 비율 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.inventory_reserve_ratio|pct}이 모두 기록상 최저인데, 매출채권과 재고는 고점 근처에 있습니다. 이번 분기 매출총이익률 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin|pct}에는 회수 가능성이 높다는 경영진 판단으로 인식한 일회성 IEEPA 관세 환급이 들어 있습니다.
summary_ko.cost_deferral: 현금과 설비를 뺀 자산 비중이 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share|pct}로 최고이지만, 원인은 인수에 따른 영업권과 무형자산이며 비용 자본화의 흔적은 없습니다. 다만 비GAAP 이익은 일회성 관세 환급은 포함하고 다른 일회성 항목은 빼서 유리하게 보이고, GAAP 영업이익에는 해마다 반복되는 Hytera 소송 이익이 들어 있습니다.
summary_ko.cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh: 최근 네 분기 매출채권 매각 대금 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.proceeds_from_sale_of_receivables}이 영업현금흐름을 받쳐 주었고, 올해 단기 매출채권 매각이 새로 나타나 이 금액을 잉여현금흐름에서 차감했습니다. 공급망 금융 잔액 {terms.balances_now.supplier_finance_obligation}은 작고 줄고 있지만, 계산에는 인수 대금 지출이 잡혀 있지 않아 품질조정 잉여현금흐름은 인수 지출 전 수치로 읽어야 합니다.
summary_ko.controls_audit_and_filing_signals: 10-Q에는 감사인 보고서가 없고, 공시통제는 유효하다고 밝혔으며, 재작성된 과거 수치도 발견되지 않았습니다. 다만 Hytera 현금 수령액 문장 삭제, 인수 계약에 대한 중요계약 8-K 부재, 언아웃 손익 계정 표기 불일치 같은 공시 일관성 문제가 있습니다.
summary_ko.cross_document_reconciliation: 8-K와 10-Q의 분기 매출 {ratios.growth.revenue.this_quarter}, 순이익 {ratios.growth.net_income.this_quarter}, 영업현금흐름 {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.this_quarter}은 서로 일치합니다. 영업권은 감소했다는 설명과 달리 총액이 늘어 모순으로 기록했지만, 올해 초 인수로 더해진 영업권이라는 무해한 해석이 가능합니다.
summary_ko.industry_lens: 재고일수가 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory}일로 기록상 최고인데 재고충당금 비율은 최저여서, 메모리 가격이나 수요가 바뀌면 재고 평가손실이 생길 위험이 있습니다. 고객 집중, 밀어내기 매출, 순환 거래는 자료에서 발견되지 않았고, 구매 약정은 자료가 없어 판단할 수 없습니다.

limits: This analysis finds where the numbers and the explanations disagree, and where the company differs from its own past. It does not judge intent, and it cannot see evidence outside the filings, such as invoices or contracts.
